experimental_method: Water saturated with the hydrocarbon (shaken or stirred, with liquid hydrocarbon present or 1 atm gas over water) at about 25 C; 0.05-0.10 ml water directly injected into a gas chromatograph with a water-absorbing fractionator, flame ionisation detector calibrated with known hydrocarbon amounts, peak areas by planimeter.
uncertainties_stated: Standard deviation of the mean from the number of determinations given; temperature not controlled closer than 25 +- 1.5 C.
quality_remarks: Gas-phase hydrocarbons at 1 atm; the author notes methane solubility (24 ppm) is anomalous relative to the vapour-pressure correlation; his values for n-pentane to n-octane are 10-20 times lower than Fuhner (1924). Short communication: experimental technique to be reported elsewhere. The PDF begins with another article (SDS enzyme) and ends with another (ATR spectra); the table is the McAuliffe table on journal page 1092.
